name: Bleeding
text: Creatures with Bleeding take damage equal to 30% of their Current Health at the start of each turn.

name: Blighted
text: Creatures with Blighted cannot be healed and take damage from healing effects equal to 50% of the effect.

name: Blind
text: Blind creatures cannot choose their targets when Attacking or Casting single-target spells.

name: Bomb
text: At the start of a creature's turn, its Bomb detonates, dealing damage equal to 80% of the afflictor's Speed. Then, this debuff is removed.

name: Burning
text: Creatures with Burning take damage based on the inflictor's Intelligence each turn.

name: Confused
text: Confused creatures have a 50% chance to Attack or Cast harmful spells on their allies.

name: Cursed
text: When creatures with Cursed deal damage with attacks or spells, they take damage equal to 100% of their target's Attack.

name: Disarmed
text: Disarmed creatures lose the benefits from their equipped Artifact, other than Health.

name: Frozen
text: Frozen creatures are unable to act until they thaw, and have a 25% chance to thaw at the start of their turn. This chance doubles after each of their turns.

name: Inverted
text: Inverted creatures heal enemies instead of damaging them with attacks and spells, and damage allies instead of healing them. This debuff is removed after enough damage or healing has been done to offset its potency.

name: Poisoned
text: Creatures with Poisoned take damage based on the inflictor's Attack each turn.

name: Scorned
text: Creatures with Scorned cannot attack. Overwrites Silenced.

name: Silenced
text: Creatures with Silenced cannot cast spells. Overwrites Scorned.

name: Sleeping
text: Creatures with Sleeping cannot act until they either take damage or this debuff wears off.

name: Snared
text: Creatures with Snared are stuck at the bottom of the Timeline until they break free. They have a 10% chance to break free at the start of each creature's turn.

name: Stone
text: Creatures with Stone cannot dodge or deal critical damage.
